title: SorobanLabs Analyzer canonical analysis report
description: Schema version 1.0.0. Describes the shape produced by analyzer_report::to_canonical_json for analyzer_report::AnalysisReport. This schema is versioned independently of the analyzer's own release version; a change that could break an existing consumer requires a new schema version.

schema_version.description: The canonical report schema version this document conforms to.

analyzer_version.description: The analyzer release version that produced this report.

protocol_context.description: The Soroban protocol number the analysis was run against, or null if none was specified.

rehearsal.description: Controlled rehearsal evidence, or null when the report predates rehearsal reporting. Present (possibly with requested=false) on every report produced by a pipeline that supports rehearsal, whether or not a rehearsal manifest was supplied.

evidence.description: Every evidence record any finding below references (by id), in encounter order. A finding's evidence entries are ids into this list.

id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 over (source, producer, location, observation); a finding's evidence array references records here by this id.

source.description: What kind of thing this evidence was examined from, plus kind-specific identifying fields (for example artifact_hash, section_name, endpoint).

producer.description: What parser, comparison, or rule produced this observation.

location.description: What location inside the source matters, if applicable.

observation.description: The bounded, human-readable fact or conclusion this evidence establishes.

requested.description: Whether the caller supplied a rehearsal manifest for this analysis run.

ran.description: Whether rehearsal execution completed for every requested invocation without the backend blocking it.

backend_used.description: The rehearsal execution backend used (for example soroban-env-host), or null when rehearsal did not run.

observations_captured.description: The kinds of observation the backend actually captured for the requested invocations (for example outcome, return_value).

observations_unavailable.description: The kinds of observation the current backend cannot capture (for example events, state_reads).

behavioral_differences_established.description: The kinds of observed behavioral difference between the current and candidate executables that rehearsal actually established.

remains_unverified.description: What rehearsal did not verify about the upgrade's runtime behavior, regardless of whether it ran.

hash.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact executable bytes.

id.description: Deterministic SHA-256 of (category, rule, subject); independent of human-readable text.
